text:
Type: striped low-pile area rug
Use: anchoring a seating area or bedside; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: modern, minimalist, Scandinavian
Materials: short dense low pile
Colors: black, off-white stripes, high contrast
Shape: rectangular, flat low pile, thin wavy hand-drawn white stripes running lengthwise, graphic, medium visual weight
Feel: graphic, bold, crisp
Goes with: white walls, light wood, grey or white sofas, black metal; monochrome, Scandinavian or modern rooms

product.name: GRLSE
product.description: The thick pile dampens sound and provides a soft surface to walk on.
